facebookresearch_robust-dynrf/scripts/ge.run_maskrcnn_segmentation: run Mask R-CNN on an image to produce a binary mask excluding people, vehicles, animals, and accessories
facebookresearch_robust-dynrf/scripts/ge.compute_sampson_error: compute the Sampson error for point correspondences given a fundamental matrix F
